title: Coral and the Hollow
author: O. M. Crane
blurb: Rosalind Okonkwo, a bone-carver who hears the dead, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
